object Statement {
  def f(w: Writer, dir: Option[Dir]): Unit = {
    w.write("x")
    dir.foreach(_.close())
    if (w.ok)
      w.flush()
    val n = w.count()
    w.abort()
  }
  def g(w: Writer): Unit =
    w.close()
  def h(w: Writer): Int = {
    w.reset()
      .count()
  }
  def i(xs: Seq[Int]): Unit = xs match {
    case Nil =>
      println("none")
      println("again")
    case _ => println("some")
  }
  def j(w: Writer): Option[Int] = {
    w.flush()
    Some(w.count())
  }
  def k(w: Writer): Int = {
    w.flush()
    w.count()
  }
  def l(w: Writer): Unit = {
    w.flush()
    w.close()
  }
}
